usage: Use map-runtime.mjs version 2 or newer for curved roads. DarkinMapPlayer.load(bundle); update(dt,dx,dy); draw(ctx,width,height). update returns a warp descriptor; your game must resolve its target map. draw(...,{drawActor(ctx,actor){...}}) integrates your CutoutPlayer. Roads are visual terrain and do not override water/collisions. No combat, NPC AI, server or Tiled importer is included.
